{{Top|leg}}
'''Randamar Parl''' was a [[Sentientologist|sapientologist]] of some repute during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. When he made first contact with the highly variable [[Xi'Dec/Legends|Xi'Dec]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Stic/Legends|Stic]], he believed that the planet was inhabited by many different [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species. In fact, the different types of lifeforms he discovered were simply different [[Gender/Legends|sexes]] of Xi'Dec.
